top_signals.title: Crop Trader Olam Agri Is Boosting Bet on Africa’s Diet Shift
top_signals.summary: Agricultural commodities trader Olam Agri is boosting investment in African food supply chains to tap the continent’s dietary shift toward more meat and processed products.

top_signals.title: US, Europe Defense Stocks Slide After Democrats’ Election Sweep
top_signals.summary: Defense stocks slid on both sides of the Atlantic as the Democrats’ landslide win in US midterm elections dented expectations of a further ramp-up in the country’s military spending.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks and Bonds Rise, Dollar Slides After US Vote: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A Democratic sweep of Congress rippled across global markets, with stocks rallying after President Donald Trump accepted the results while bond yields and the dollar fell on expectations of greater limits on his agenda.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
